selected_offers.product_variant: TATTU 650mAh 2S 7.4V 75C LiPo Battery Pack with XT30 Plug
selected_offers.acceptance: Standard 2S LiPo, 8.4 V full (HV packs reach 8.7 V), so the servos run with Shutdown = 52; 57 x 31 x 12 mm, 43 g (page text) fits the layout F box outline; XT30 female battery lead; 75C covers the 8.3 A peak.
selected_offers.cheaper_elsewhere: ReadyMadeRC $8.19 plus estimated $9-13 ground shipping: not cheaper landed.

selected_offers.acceptance: Charging and storage bag for two 57 x 31 x 12 mm packs; 4.8 stars from 2,415 ratings; brings the order over the $25 same-day threshold.
selected_offers.cheaper_elsewhere: RDQ pouch $7.49 plus ground shipping: not cheaper landed.

selected_offers.product_variant: 10 Pairs XT30 Connector Male Female Amass XT30U Plug Black with Heat Shrink
selected_offers.acceptance: Original Amass XT30U solder-cup pairs, 15 A rated (page text); one male for the backpack feed lead, one female for the backpack servo lead; spares.
selected_offers.cheaper_elsewhere: Pyrodrone Amass 5-packs $2.99 per gender plus ground shipping: not cheaper landed for this order.

selected_offers.product_variant: 10 Pairs Amass MR30 Male Female Connector Plug
selected_offers.acceptance: Amass MR30 solder-cup pairs, 30 A continuous per listing; a connector shape distinct from XT30 for the A7Z 5 V joint (robot male, battery and bench backpack females), so battery voltage cannot reach the A7Z lead.
selected_offers.cheaper_elsewhere: Not checked elsewhere; the 5-pair Amazon packs cost the same $9.99.

selected_offers.product_variant: LiPo Battery Charger 2S 3S Balance Charger, Black
selected_offers.acceptance: AC 100-240 V, 800 mA balance charge on the JST-XH lead (about 1.2C for 650 mAh). Left unselected: select it only if RoboClub lends no charger.
selected_offers.cheaper_elsewhere: ISDT UC2 at RDQ $8.99 plus ground shipping, 7-8 business days: not cheaper landed.
